title: Patients With Personality: Realistic Patient Simulation through Controlled Diversity and Selective Disclosure
abstract: arXiv:2606.17441v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Realistic patient simulation is a key requirement for developing and testing clinical LLMs at scale without costly user studies. Existing simulators lack realism and controllability: they overshare information and miss the variability of real patient behavior. Here, we introduce PatientsWithPersonality (PWP), a patient simulation framework that generates realistic yet diverse patient responses through explicit personality parametrization over a latent patient state. Grounded in the six-dimensional HEXACO personality model, it gives fine-grained control over conversational style, cooperativeness, and information disclosure. We evaluate PWP in the first direct comparison of different patient simulators under a shared protocol, anchored in transcripts of real physician-patient encounters. Clinicians judge PWP conversations as realistic at least as often as the recorded encounters themselves and far more often than prior simulators

translated_title: 具有人格的患者：通过可控多样性与选择性披露实现真实患者模拟
translated_abstract: 真实患者模拟是在无需昂贵用户研究的情况下大规模开发和测试临床大语言模型的关键需求。现有模拟器缺乏真实性和可控性：它们会过度分享信息，且无法体现真实患者行为的多样性。本文提出了PatientsWithPersonality（PWP），这是一个患者模拟框架，通过对潜在患者状态进行显式人格参数化，生成真实且多样的患者响应。该框架基于六维HEXACO人格模型，能够对对话风格、配合度和信息披露进行细粒度控制。我们在首个共享协议下对不同患者模拟器进行直接比较的评估中评估了PWP，该评估以真实医患就诊对话记录为基准。临床医生认为PWP对话的真实性至少与真实就诊记录相当，且远高于以往模拟器。
tldr: 提出了基于六维HEXACO人格模型的患者模拟框架PWP，通过显式人格参数化实现对对话风格、配合度和信息披露的细粒度控制，其对话真实性经临床医生评估与真实医患对话相当，且远超以往模拟器。
en_tdlr: PWP is a patient simulation framework grounded in the six-dimensional HEXACO personality model that enables fine-grained control over conversational style, cooperativeness, and information disclosure, achieving realism rated by clinicians as comparable to real physician-patient encounters and far surpassing prior simulators.
